items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance criteria (AC) are the specific conditions that must be true for an item to count as correctly done.", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance criteria (AC) are the specific conditions that must be true for an item to count as correctly done.", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. Số nhiều: criteria; "acceptance criteria" = tiêu chí chấp nhận (khi nào coi là xong).
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (noun): a standard for judging. Plural: criteria; "acceptance criteria" define when an item counts as done.

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance criteria (AC) are the specific conditions that must be true for an item to count as correctly done.", từ "count as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance criteria (AC) are the specific conditions that must be true for an item to count as correctly done.", what does "count as" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: count as /kaʊnt æz/ (cụm từ): được xem là. "Count as done" = được coi là hoàn thành; "that does not count" = cái đó không tính.
items.explanationEn: count as /kaʊnt æz/ (phrase): to be considered as. "Count as done" means being accepted as finished; "that does not count" means it is not accepted.

items.question: Trong câu "Written in business language, without technical jargon.", từ "jargon" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Written in business language, without technical jargon.", what does "jargon" (noun) mean?
options: thuật ngữ chuyên môn khó hiểu
items.explanation: jargon /ˈdʒɑː.ɡən/ (danh từ): thuật ngữ chuyên môn khó hiểu. "Avoid technical jargon" = tránh thuật ngữ kỹ thuật để người dùng đọc và xác nhận được.
items.explanationEn: jargon /ˈdʒɑː.ɡən/ (noun): terms only experts understand. "Avoid technical jargon" so business users can read and confirm the text.

items.question: Trong câu "Covering exception conditions, not only the happy path.", từ "exception" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Covering exception conditions, not only the happy path.", what does "exception" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a case outside the usual rule
items.explanation: exception /ɪkˈsep.ʃən/ (danh từ): trường hợp ngoại lệ. "Exception conditions" = các điều kiện ngoại lệ; "take exception to" (nghĩa khác) = phật ý.
items.explanationEn: exception /ɪkˈsep.ʃən/ (noun): a case outside the usual rule. "Exception conditions" are unusual cases; "take exception to" (another sense) means to be offended.

items.question: Trong câu "Covering exception conditions, not only the happy path.", từ "happy path" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Covering exception conditions, not only the happy path.", what does "happy path" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: the flow where nothing goes wrong
items.explanation: happy path /ˈhæp.i pɑːθ/ (cụm từ): luồng chính suôn sẻ. "Happy path" = kịch bản mọi thứ diễn ra đúng như mong đợi; AC tốt phải bao cả luồng lỗi.
items.explanationEn: happy path /ˈhæp.i pɑːθ/ (phrase): the flow where nothing goes wrong. The "happy path" is the scenario where everything works; good AC also cover failures.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most frequently omitted part.", từ "omit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most frequently omitted part.", what does "omit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: omit /əˈmɪt/ (động từ): bỏ sót. "Omit a detail" = bỏ sót chi tiết; danh từ: omission.
items.explanationEn: omit /əˈmɪt/ (verb): to leave out. "Omit a detail" means leaving it out; noun: omission.

items.question: Trong câu "Agreed BEFORE implementation begins, not afterwards.", từ "implementation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agreed BEFORE implementation begins, not afterwards.", what does "implementation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: implementation /ˌɪm.plɪ.menˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): việc triển khai. "Before implementation begins" = trước khi bắt đầu hiện thực hóa (code); động từ: implement.
items.explanationEn: implementation /ˌɪm.plɪ.menˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): putting a plan into action. "Before implementation begins" means before the build starts; verb: implement.

items.question: Trong câu "Agreed BEFORE implementation begins, not afterwards.", từ "afterwards" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agreed BEFORE implementation begins, not afterwards.", what does "afterwards" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: afterwards /ˈɑːf.tə.wədz/ (trạng từ): sau đó. Afterwards (Anh-Anh) / afterward (Anh-Mỹ); AC phải thống nhất trước, không phải sau.
items.explanationEn: afterwards /ˈɑːf.tə.wədz/ (adverb): at a later time. Afterwards (UK) / afterward (US); AC must be agreed before, not after.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most widely used way to write AC, because it forces you to state the three things an under-specified requirement usually omits.", từ "widely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most widely used way to write AC, because it forces you to state the three things an under-specified requirement usually omits.", what does "widely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: widely /ˈwaɪd.li/ (trạng từ): rộng rãi. "Widely used / accepted" = được dùng / chấp nhận rộng rãi.
items.explanationEn: widely /ˈwaɪd.li/ (adverb): by many people. "Widely used / accepted" means used or accepted by many.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most widely used way to write AC, because it forces you to state the three things an under-specified requirement usually omits.", từ "force" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most widely used way to write AC, because it forces you to state the three things an under-specified requirement usually omits.", what does "force" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: force /fɔːs/ (động từ): buộc phải. "Force someone to do something" = buộc ai làm gì; Given-When-Then buộc bạn nêu đủ ba phần.
items.explanationEn: force /fɔːs/ (verb): to make someone do. "Force someone to do something" means making them do it; Given-When-Then makes you state all three parts.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most widely used way to write AC, because it forces you to state the three things an under-specified requirement usually omits.", từ "under-specified" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most widely used way to write AC, because it forces you to state the three things an under-specified requirement usually omits.", what does "under-specified" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: under-specified /ˌʌn.dəˈspes.ɪ.faɪd/ (tính từ): đặc tả chưa đủ. Tiền tố under- = chưa đủ (under-specified, underestimate); đối lập: over-specified.
items.explanationEn: under-specified /ˌʌn.dəˈspes.ɪ.faɪd/ (adjective): not described in enough detail. The prefix under- means not enough (under-specified, underestimate); opposite: over-specified.

items.question: Trong câu "Given the cart contains at least one in-stock product", từ "in-stock" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Given the cart contains at least one in-stock product", what does "in-stock" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: in-stock /ˌɪnˈstɒk/ (tính từ): còn hàng. "In stock" = còn hàng; "out of stock" = hết hàng; "stock" = hàng tồn kho.
items.explanationEn: in-stock /ˌɪnˈstɒk/ (adjective): available to sell now. "In stock" means available; "out of stock" means sold out; "stock" is the goods held.

items.question: Trong câu "When the user confirms the order with valid delivery details", từ "valid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the user confirms the order with valid delivery details", what does "valid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: valid /ˈvæl.ɪd/ (tính từ): hợp lệ. "Valid input / data" = dữ liệu hợp lệ; "a valid point" (nghĩa khác) = ý kiến có lý.
items.explanationEn: valid /ˈvæl.ɪd/ (adjective): meeting the rules. "Valid input / data" meets the rules; "a valid point" (another sense) is a sound argument.

items.question: Trong câu "Then the system creates an order in Pending Confirmation status, decrements stock, and sends a confirmation email within 1 minute", từ "decrement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Then the system creates an order in Pending Confirmation status, decrements stock, and sends a confirmation email within 1 minute", what does "decrement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decrement /ˈdek.rɪ.mənt/ (động từ): giảm đi (một lượng). "Decrement stock" = trừ tồn kho; đối lập: increment (tăng).
items.explanationEn: decrement /ˈdek.rɪ.mənt/ (verb): to reduce by an amount. "Decrement stock" means reducing the stock count; opposite: increment.

items.question: Trong câu "AC2 — Product goes out of stock in the meantime", từ "in the meantime" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AC2 — Product goes out of stock in the meantime", what does "in the meantime" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in the meantime /ɪn ðə ˈmiːn.taɪm/ (cụm từ): trong lúc đó. "In the meantime" = trong khoảng thời gian chờ đợi đó; hay dùng trong email: "In the meantime, ...".
items.explanationEn: in the meantime /ɪn ðə ˈmiːn.taɪm/ (phrase): during that time. "In the meantime" means while waiting; common in emails: "In the meantime, ..."

items.question: Trong câu "Then the system shows a message naming which product is unavailable, preserves the cart, and does NOT create an order", từ "unavailable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Then the system shows a message naming which product is unavailable, preserves the cart, and does NOT create an order", what does "unavailable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unavailable /ˌʌn.əˈveɪ.lə.bəl/ (tính từ): không có sẵn. "Product unavailable" = sản phẩm không có sẵn; "I am unavailable" (nghĩa khác) = tôi bận.
items.explanationEn: unavailable /ˌʌn.əˈveɪ.lə.bəl/ (adjective): not able to be obtained. "Product unavailable" means it cannot be bought; "I am unavailable" (another sense) means busy.

items.question: Trong câu "Then the system shows a message naming which product is unavailable, preserves the cart, and does NOT create an order", từ "preserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Then the system shows a message naming which product is unavailable, preserves the cart, and does NOT create an order", what does "preserve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): giữ nguyên. "Preserve the cart / data" = giữ nguyên giỏ hàng / dữ liệu, không làm mất.
items.explanationEn: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to keep unchanged. "Preserve the cart / data" means keeping it intact.

items.question: Trong câu "When the connection to the payment gateway fails", từ "gateway" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the connection to the payment gateway fails", what does "gateway" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gateway /ˈɡeɪt.weɪ/ (danh từ): cổng kết nối (dịch vụ). "Payment gateway" = cổng thanh toán; nghĩa gốc gateway = cổng ra vào.
items.explanationEn: gateway /ˈɡeɪt.weɪ/ (noun): a service linking systems. "Payment gateway" is the service that processes payments; literally, an entrance gate.

items.question: Trong câu "Then the system keeps the order in Awaiting Payment status, shows retry guidance, and does NOT decrement stock a second time", từ "guidance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Then the system keeps the order in Awaiting Payment status, shows retry guidance, and does NOT decrement stock a second time", what does "guidance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: guidance /ˈɡaɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): hướng dẫn. "Provide guidance" = đưa ra hướng dẫn; động từ: guide.
items.explanationEn: guidance /ˈɡaɪ.dəns/ (noun): advice on what to do. "Provide guidance" means giving advice on what to do; verb: guide.

items.question: Trong câu "A story is only truly done when the system handles what can go wrong.", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A story is only truly done when the system handles what can go wrong.", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (động từ): xử lý. "Handle errors / exceptions" = xử lý lỗi / ngoại lệ; danh từ handle = tay cầm.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (verb): to deal with. "Handle errors / exceptions" means dealing with them; the noun means a grip.

items.question: Trong câu "There is no fixed number, but there are useful indicators:", từ "fixed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is no fixed number, but there are useful indicators:", what does "fixed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fixed /fɪkst/ (tính từ): cố định. "No fixed number" = không có con số cố định; "fixed price" = giá cố định.
items.explanationEn: fixed /fɪkst/ (adjective): not changing. "No fixed number" means it varies; "fixed price" is a set price.

items.question: Trong câu "There is no fixed number, but there are useful indicators:", từ "indicator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is no fixed number, but there are useful indicators:", what does "indicator" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tər/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu, chỉ báo. "Key performance indicator (KPI)" = chỉ số hiệu suất chính; động từ: indicate.
items.explanationEn: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tər/ (noun): a sign that shows something. "Key performance indicator (KPI)" is a common term; verb: indicate.

items.question: Trong câu "Too many (over 10 AC) → the story is probably too large and should be split.", từ "split" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Too many (over 10 AC) → the story is probably too large and should be split.", what does "split" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: split /splɪt/ (động từ): tách nhỏ. "Split a story" = tách user story lớn thành các story nhỏ hơn.
items.explanationEn: split /splɪt/ (verb): to divide into parts. "Split a story" means breaking a large user story into smaller ones.

items.question: Trong câu "No AC covering a failure case → something is certainly missing.", từ "certainly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No AC covering a failure case → something is certainly missing.", what does "certainly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: certainly /ˈsɜː.tən.li/ (trạng từ): chắc chắn. "Certainly" mạnh hơn "probably"; trong hội thoại "Certainly!" = Tất nhiên rồi!
items.explanationEn: certainly /ˈsɜː.tən.li/ (adverb): without doubt. "Certainly" is stronger than "probably"; in speech "Certainly!" means of course.

items.question: Trong câu "What if the user acts twice in quick succession?", từ "in quick succession" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What if the user acts twice in quick succession?", what does "in quick succession" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in quick succession /ɪn kwɪk səkˈseʃ.ən/ (cụm từ): liên tiếp rất nhanh. "In quick succession" = liên tiếp nhanh; ví dụ bấm nút hai lần liền gây tạo trùng đơn.
items.explanationEn: in quick succession /ɪn kwɪk səkˈseʃ.ən/ (phrase): one right after another. "In quick succession" means one right after another, like a double click creating duplicate orders.

items.question: Trong câu "Are there value limits to state (length, numeric range, format)?", từ "range" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Are there value limits to state (length, numeric range, format)?", what does "range" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: range /reɪndʒ/ (danh từ): khoảng giá trị. "Numeric range" = khoảng giá trị số; "within range" = trong khoảng cho phép.
items.explanationEn: range /reɪndʒ/ (noun): the span between limits. "Numeric range" is the span of allowed numbers; "within range" means allowed.

items.question: Trong câu "A pragmatic rule: if a tester cannot write a test case from your AC, the AC is not yet sufficient.", từ "sufficient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A pragmatic rule: if a tester cannot write a test case from your AC, the AC is not yet sufficient.", what does "sufficient" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sufficient /səˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (tính từ): đủ. "Sufficient information" = đủ thông tin; trái nghĩa: insufficient.
items.explanationEn: sufficient /səˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (adjective): enough for the purpose. "Sufficient information" is enough information; opposite: insufficient.

items.question: Trong câu "A business rule is a policy or rule of the organization that exists independently of software and usually outlives every system.", từ "independently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A business rule is a policy or rule of the organization that exists independently of software and usually outlives every system.", what does "independently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: independently /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách độc lập. "Exist independently of software" = tồn tại không phụ thuộc vào phần mềm.
items.explanationEn: independently /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt.li/ (adverb): without depending on. "Exist independently of software" means existing without relying on it.

items.question: Trong câu "A business rule is a policy or rule of the organization that exists independently of software and usually outlives every system.", từ "outlive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A business rule is a policy or rule of the organization that exists independently of software and usually outlives every system.", what does "outlive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (động từ): tồn tại lâu hơn. Tiền tố out- = hơn (outlive, outperform); quy tắc nghiệp vụ thường sống lâu hơn hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (verb): to last longer than. The prefix out- means more than (outlive, outperform); business rules usually outlast systems.

items.question: Trong câu "A business rule is a policy or rule of the organization that exists independently of software and usually outlives every system.", từ "policy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A business rule is a policy or rule of the organization that exists independently of software and usually outlives every system.", what does "policy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: policy /ˈpɒl.ə.si/ (danh từ): chính sách. "Company policy" = chính sách công ty; "insurance policy" (nghĩa khác) = hợp đồng bảo hiểm.
items.explanationEn: policy /ˈpɒl.ə.si/ (noun): a set of official rules. "Company policy" is an official rule; "insurance policy" (another sense) is a contract.

items.question: Trong câu "Before the system existed, that rule was enforced on paper by people.", từ "enforce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before the system existed, that rule was enforced on paper by people.", what does "enforce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (động từ): thi hành, áp dụng. "Enforce a rule / law" = thực thi quy tắc / luật; danh từ: enforcement.
items.explanationEn: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (verb): to make people obey. "Enforce a rule / law" means making sure it is obeyed; noun: enforcement.

items.question: Trong câu "Before the system existed, that rule was enforced on paper by people.", từ "on paper" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before the system existed, that rule was enforced on paper by people.", what does "on paper" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on paper /ɒn ˈpeɪ.pər/ (cụm từ): bằng giấy tờ. "On paper" ở đây = bằng giấy tờ thủ công; nghĩa bóng khác: "on paper" = trên lý thuyết.
items.explanationEn: on paper /ɒn ˈpeɪ.pər/ (phrase): in written documents. "On paper" here means in physical documents; figuratively it can mean in theory.

items.question: Trong câu "One business rule can generate several functional requirements in different parts of the system: one on the order screen, one on the approval screen, one in reporting, one in the API.", từ "generate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One business rule can generate several functional requirements in different parts of the system: one on the order screen, one on the approval screen, one in reporting, one in the API.", what does "generate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: generate /ˈdʒen.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): tạo ra. "Generate requirements / revenue" = tạo ra yêu cầu / doanh thu.
items.explanationEn: generate /ˈdʒen.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to produce. "Generate requirements / revenue" means producing them.

items.question: Trong câu "One business rule can generate several functional requirements in different parts of the system: one on the order screen, one on the approval screen, one in reporting, one in the API.", từ "functional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One business rule can generate several functional requirements in different parts of the system: one on the order screen, one on the approval screen, one in reporting, one in the API.", what does "functional" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: functional /ˈfʌŋk.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): thuộc chức năng. "Functional requirement" = yêu cầu chức năng; "non-functional" = yêu cầu phi chức năng (hiệu năng, bảo mật).
items.explanationEn: functional /ˈfʌŋk.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): about what a system does. "Functional requirement" describes behaviour; "non-functional" covers qualities like performance.

items.question: Trong câu "This is one of the highest-value practices that few teams adopt.", từ "practice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is one of the highest-value practices that few teams adopt.", what does "practice" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: practice /ˈpræk.tɪs/ (danh từ): cách làm, thông lệ. "Best practice" = cách làm tốt nhất đã được công nhận.
items.explanationEn: practice /ˈpræk.tɪs/ (noun): a usual way of working. "Best practice" is the accepted best way of doing something.

items.question: Trong câu "This is one of the highest-value practices that few teams adopt.", từ "adopt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is one of the highest-value practices that few teams adopt.", what does "adopt" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: adopt /əˈdɒpt/ (động từ): áp dụng. "Adopt a practice / a tool" = áp dụng một cách làm / công cụ; danh từ: adoption.
items.explanationEn: adopt /əˈdɒpt/ (verb): to start using. "Adopt a practice / a tool" means starting to use it; noun: adoption.

items.question: Trong câu "An approval threshold can move from 50 to 100 million without anything else changing.", từ "threshold" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An approval threshold can move from 50 to 100 million without anything else changing.", what does "threshold" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: threshold /ˈθreʃ.həʊld/ (danh từ): ngưỡng. "Approval threshold" = ngưỡng cần phê duyệt; "exceed the threshold" = vượt ngưỡng.
items.explanationEn: threshold /ˈθreʃ.həʊld/ (noun): a level that triggers action. "Approval threshold" is the level that requires approval; "exceed the threshold" means go above it.

items.question: Trong câu "One rule applies in several places.", từ "apply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One rule applies in several places.", what does "apply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (động từ): áp dụng, có hiệu lực. "The rule applies to..." = quy tắc áp dụng cho…; "apply for a job" (nghĩa khác) = nộp đơn xin việc.
items.explanationEn: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (verb): to be relevant, take effect. "The rule applies to..." means it is relevant there; "apply for a job" (another sense) means request one.

items.question: Trong câu "Keeping them separate clarifies who has the authority to change them.", từ "clarify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keeping them separate clarifies who has the authority to change them.", what does "clarify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clarify /ˈklær.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): làm rõ. "Could you clarify...?" = Bạn làm rõ giúp…? Câu hỏi rất lịch sự trong công việc; danh từ: clarification.
items.explanationEn: clarify /ˈklær.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to make clear. "Could you clarify...?" is a polite work question; noun: clarification.

items.question: Trong câu "Keeping them separate clarifies who has the authority to change them.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keeping them separate clarifies who has the authority to change them.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): thẩm quyền. "Have the authority to..." = có thẩm quyền làm…; "the authorities" (nghĩa khác) = nhà chức trách.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): the right to decide. "Have the authority to..." means having the right to; "the authorities" (another sense) are officials.

items.question: Trong câu "The most important field is ORIGIN.", từ "origin" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most important field is ORIGIN.", what does "origin" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: origin /ˈɒr.ɪ.dʒɪn/ (danh từ): nguồn gốc. "The origin of a rule" = nguồn gốc quy tắc (luật, chính sách nội bộ…); tính từ: original.
items.explanationEn: origin /ˈɒr.ɪ.dʒɪn/ (noun): where something comes from. "The origin of a rule" is its source, such as a law or internal policy; adjective: original.

items.question: Trong câu "It tells you whether the rule is negotiable and whom to consult when a change is needed.", từ "consult" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It tells you whether the rule is negotiable and whom to consult when a change is needed.", what does "consult" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to look up in a book
items.explanation: consult /kənˈsʌlt/ (động từ): hỏi ý kiến. "Consult someone" = hỏi ý kiến ai; "consultant" = chuyên gia tư vấn.
items.explanationEn: consult /kənˈsʌlt/ (verb): to ask for advice. "Consult someone" means asking their advice; a "consultant" gives expert advice.

items.question: Trong câu "What is mandatory or forbidden.", từ "forbidden" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What is mandatory or forbidden.", what does "forbidden" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: forbidden /fəˈbɪd.ən/ (tính từ): bị cấm. Động từ: forbid (forbade, forbidden); HTTP 403 Forbidden = bị cấm truy cập.
items.explanationEn: forbidden /fəˈbɪd.ən/ (adjective): not allowed. Verb: forbid (forbade, forbidden); HTTP 403 Forbidden means access denied.

items.question: Trong câu "When a condition becomes true, an action must occur.", từ "occur" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a condition becomes true, an action must occur.", what does "occur" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: occur /əˈkɜːr/ (động từ): xảy ra. "An error occurred" = đã xảy ra lỗi; "it occurred to me" (nghĩa khác) = tôi chợt nghĩ ra.
items.explanationEn: occur /əˈkɜːr/ (verb): to happen. "An error occurred" means one happened; "it occurred to me" (another sense) means I thought of it.

items.question: Trong câu "Deriving one fact from another.", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deriving one fact from another.", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): suy ra. "Derive A from B" = suy ra A từ B; "derived data" = dữ liệu dẫn xuất.
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to obtain from a source. "Derive A from B" means getting A from B; "derived data" is calculated from other data.

items.question: Trong câu "A formula for calculating a value.", từ "formula" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A formula for calculating a value.", what does "formula" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: formula /ˈfɔː.mjə.lə/ (danh từ): công thức. "Formula" số nhiều: formulas / formulae; ví dụ công thức tính phí giao hàng.
items.explanationEn: formula /ˈfɔː.mjə.lə/ (noun): a rule written in symbols. "Formula" plural: formulas / formulae; e.g. the rule for calculating a delivery fee.

items.question: Trong câu "Inferences are the most frequently missed kind.", từ "inference" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Inferences are the most frequently missed kind.", what does "inference" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: inference /ˈɪn.fər.əns/ (danh từ): sự suy luận. Động từ: infer (suy ra); đừng nhầm với interference (sự can thiệp).
items.explanationEn: inference /ˈɪn.fər.əns/ (noun): a conclusion reached by reasoning. Verb: infer; do not confuse it with interference.

items.question: Trong câu "They live implicitly in the heads of business staff and nobody thinks to say them aloud — until the system misclassifies an important customer.", từ "implicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They live implicitly in the heads of business staff and nobody thinks to say them aloud — until the system misclassifies an important customer.", what does "implicitly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: implicitly /ɪmˈplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): ngầm, không nói ra. "Implicitly" đối lập "explicitly" (rõ ràng); quy tắc ngầm dễ bị bỏ sót nhất.
items.explanationEn: implicitly /ɪmˈplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): without being stated. "Implicitly" is the opposite of "explicitly"; unstated rules are the easiest to miss.

items.question: Trong câu "They live implicitly in the heads of business staff and nobody thinks to say them aloud — until the system misclassifies an important customer.", từ "aloud" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They live implicitly in the heads of business staff and nobody thinks to say them aloud — until the system misclassifies an important customer.", what does "aloud" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: aloud /əˈlaʊd/ (trạng từ): thành tiếng. "Say something aloud" = nói thành lời; "think aloud" = vừa nghĩ vừa nói ra.
items.explanationEn: aloud /əˈlaʊd/ (adverb): out loud. "Say something aloud" means speaking it; "think aloud" means voicing your thoughts.

items.question: Trong câu "They live implicitly in the heads of business staff and nobody thinks to say them aloud — until the system misclassifies an important customer.", từ "misclassify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They live implicitly in the heads of business staff and nobody thinks to say them aloud — until the system misclassifies an important customer.", what does "misclassify" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put in the wrong group
items.explanation: misclassify /ˌmɪsˈklæs.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): phân loại sai. Tiền tố mis- = sai; "misclassify a customer" = xếp khách hàng vào nhóm sai.
items.explanationEn: misclassify /ˌmɪsˈklæs.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to put in the wrong group. The prefix mis- means wrongly; "misclassify a customer" puts them in the wrong group.

items.question: Trong câu "Classifying them helps you notice which kind you are missing.", từ "notice" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Classifying them helps you notice which kind you are missing.", what does "notice" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: notice /ˈnəʊ.tɪs/ (động từ): nhận ra. "Notice a gap" = nhận ra lỗ hổng; danh từ notice = thông báo.
items.explanationEn: notice /ˈnəʊ.tɪs/ (verb): to become aware of. "Notice a gap" means spotting it; the noun means an announcement.

items.question: Trong câu "The right way to link them: AC reference a business rule rather than repeating its content.", từ "reference" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The right way to link them: AC reference a business rule rather than repeating its content.", what does "reference" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reference /ˈref.ər.əns/ (động từ): dẫn chiếu tới. "Reference BR-012" = dẫn chiếu đến quy tắc BR-012 thay vì chép lại nội dung.
items.explanationEn: reference /ˈref.ər.əns/ (verb): to point to a source. "Reference BR-012" means pointing to the rule instead of copying its content.

items.question: Trong câu "Given the user creates an order whose total exceeds the threshold defined in BR-012", từ "exceed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Given the user creates an order whose total exceeds the threshold defined in BR-012", what does "exceed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (động từ): vượt quá. "Exceed the limit / expectations" = vượt giới hạn / vượt kỳ vọng.
items.explanationEn: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (verb): to go beyond. "Exceed the limit / expectations" means going beyond it.

items.question: Trong câu "Then the system moves the order to Pending Approval and notifies the sales manager", từ "notify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Then the system moves the order to Pending Approval and notifies the sales manager", what does "notify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: notify /ˈnəʊ.tɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): thông báo cho. "Notify someone of something" = thông báo cho ai về việc gì; danh từ: notification.
items.explanationEn: notify /ˈnəʊ.tɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to inform formally. "Notify someone of something" means informing them; noun: notification.

items.question: Trong câu "The benefit: when the threshold moves from 50 to 100 million, you change BR-012 in one place.", từ "benefit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The benefit: when the threshold moves from 50 to 100 million, you change BR-012 in one place.", what does "benefit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: benefit /ˈben.ɪ.fɪt/ (danh từ): lợi ích. "Costs and benefits" = chi phí và lợi ích; "employee benefits" (nghĩa khác) = phúc lợi.
items.explanationEn: benefit /ˈben.ɪ.fɪt/ (noun): an advantage. "Costs and benefits" is a common pair; "employee benefits" (another sense) are perks.

items.question: Trong câu "Every AC referencing it remains correct automatically.", từ "automatically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every AC referencing it remains correct automatically.", what does "automatically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: automatically /ˌɔː.təˈmæt.ɪ.kəl.i/ (trạng từ): tự động. Khi AC dẫn chiếu quy tắc, sửa quy tắc một chỗ thì mọi AC tự động đúng.
items.explanationEn: automatically /ˌɔː.təˈmæt.ɪ.kəl.i/ (adverb): without manual action. When AC reference a rule, one edit to the rule keeps every AC correct automatically.

items.question: Trong câu "The same principle applies in the system: because business rules change often, they should live where they can be changed without reprogramming — a configuration table, a rule engine, or at minimum one centralised module.", từ "at minimum" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same principle applies in the system: because business rules change often, they should live where they can be changed without reprogramming — a configuration table, a rule engine, or at minimum one centralised module.", what does "at minimum" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at minimum /æt ˈmɪn.ɪ.məm/ (cụm từ): ít nhất. "At minimum" = tối thiểu thì; đồng nghĩa: at least, at a minimum.
items.explanationEn: at minimum /æt ˈmɪn.ɪ.məm/ (phrase): at the very least. "At minimum" means at the very least; synonyms: at least, at a minimum.

items.question: Trong câu "The same principle applies in the system: because business rules change often, they should live where they can be changed without reprogramming — a configuration table, a rule engine, or at minimum one centralised module.", từ "centralised" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same principle applies in the system: because business rules change often, they should live where they can be changed without reprogramming — a configuration table, a rule engine, or at minimum one centralised module.", what does "centralised" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: centralised /ˈsen.trə.laɪzd/ (tính từ): tập trung một chỗ. Centralised (Anh-Anh) / centralized (Anh-Mỹ); đối lập: decentralised (phân tán).
items.explanationEn: centralised /ˈsen.trə.laɪzd/ (adjective): gathered in one place. Centralised (UK) / centralized (US); opposite: decentralised.

items.question: Trong câu "When it changes, must it be applied retroactively to existing data?", từ "retroactively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When it changes, must it be applied retroactively to existing data?", what does "retroactively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: retroactively /ˌret.rəʊˈæk.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): có hiệu lực hồi tố. "Apply retroactively" = áp dụng hồi tố cho dữ liệu đã có; tính từ: retroactive.
items.explanationEn: retroactively /ˌret.rəʊˈæk.tɪv.li/ (adverb): affecting the past. "Apply retroactively" means applying a change to past data; adjective: retroactive.

items.question: Trong câu "Are there exceptions, and who may override it?", từ "override" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Are there exceptions, and who may override it?", what does "override" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set aside by higher authority
items.explanation: override /ˌəʊ.vəˈraɪd/ (động từ): vượt quyền bỏ qua. "Override a rule" = dùng quyền để bỏ qua quy tắc; trong lập trình "override" = ghi đè phương thức.
items.explanationEn: override /ˌəʊ.vəˈraɪd/ (verb): to set aside by higher authority. "Override a rule" means setting it aside with authority; in programming it means redefining a method.

items.question: Trong câu "Is an override logged?", từ "log" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is an override logged?", what does "log" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: log /lɒɡ/ (động từ): ghi nhật ký. "Log an event" = ghi lại sự kiện; khác "log in" = đăng nhập.
items.explanationEn: log /lɒɡ/ (verb): to record in a log. "Log an event" means recording it; different from "log in" = sign in.

items.question: Trong câu "The retroactive question is the most frequently omitted and the source of the most serious business incidents.", từ "incident" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The retroactive question is the most frequently omitted and the source of the most serious business incidents.", what does "incident" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: incident /ˈɪn.sɪ.dənt/ (danh từ): sự cố. "A serious incident" = sự cố nghiêm trọng; "incident report" = báo cáo sự cố.
items.explanationEn: incident /ˈɪn.sɪ.dənt/ (noun): an unexpected bad event. "A serious incident" is a major problem; "incident report" documents it.

items.question: Trong câu "If the approval threshold changes, are orders already pending processed under the old rule or the new one?", từ "pending" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the approval threshold changes, are orders already pending processed under the old rule or the new one?", what does "pending" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pending /ˈpen.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): đang chờ xử lý. "Pending approval" = đang chờ phê duyệt; giới từ pending = trong khi chờ.
items.explanationEn: pending /ˈpen.dɪŋ/ (adjective): waiting to be dealt with. "Pending approval" means waiting for approval; as a preposition it means while waiting for.

items.question: Trong câu "Good AC are specific, verifiable, in business language, cover exceptions, and agreed before implementation.", từ "verifiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Good AC are specific, verifiable, in business language, cover exceptions, and agreed before implementation.", what does "verifiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: verifiable /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể kiểm chứng. "Verifiable" = kiểm chứng được; "fast" không kiểm chứng được, "trong 2 giây" thì được.
items.explanationEn: verifiable /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be checked. "Verifiable" means checkable; "fast" is not, "within 2 seconds" is.

items.question: Trong câu "Only 1–2 AC for a medium story signals you described only the happy path.", từ "signal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Only 1–2 AC for a medium story signals you described only the happy path.", what does "signal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (động từ): cho thấy dấu hiệu. "Signal a problem" = báo hiệu vấn đề; danh từ signal = tín hiệu.
items.explanationEn: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (verb): to be a sign of. "Signal a problem" means indicating it; the noun means a sign or transmission.

items.question: Trong câu "AC are the shared contract between BA, developer, and tester about what done means, so write them together and agree them first.", từ "contract" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AC are the shared contract between BA, developer, and tester about what done means, so write them together and agree them first.", what does "contract" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: contract /ˈkɒn.trækt/ (danh từ): giao ước, thỏa thuận. "Shared contract" (nghĩa bóng) = sự thống nhất chung giữa các bên; động từ contract còn nghĩa là co lại.
items.explanationEn: contract /ˈkɒn.trækt/ (noun): a binding agreement. "Shared contract" figuratively means a common agreement; the verb can also mean to shrink.

items.question: Trong câu "Given-When-Then is an omission-prevention tool, especially effective for failure and exception cases.", từ "omission" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Given-When-Then is an omission-prevention tool, especially effective for failure and exception cases.", what does "omission" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: omission /əˈmɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): sự bỏ sót. "Errors and omissions" = sai sót và bỏ sót; động từ: omit.
items.explanationEn: omission /əˈmɪʃ.ən/ (noun): something left out. "Errors and omissions" is a common pair; verb: omit.

items.question: Trong câu "Business rules are organizational assets, not project assets — separate them, give them IDs, and record their origin.", từ "asset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Business rules are organizational assets, not project assets — separate them, give them IDs, and record their origin.", what does "asset" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a media file for an app
items.explanation: asset /ˈæs.et/ (danh từ): tài sản. "Organizational asset" = tài sản của tổ chức; trong phát triển web "assets" còn là ảnh, font, CSS.
items.explanationEn: asset /ˈæs.et/ (noun): something of lasting value. "An organizational asset" is valuable to the whole organization; in web work "assets" also means images and fonts.
